entities.name: Two-lane highway

entities.name: Gravel and desert terrain on both sides of the highway
entities.identification: The gray gravel strips outside the road shoulders, as well as the exposed yellowish-brown dry ground farther out.

entities.name: Dry grass and shrubs on both sides of the highway
entities.identification: Groups of roadside vegetation composed of yellowish-brown dry grass and low green shrubs.
